S003 substitutes the witness's coefficient and generalizes the arbitrary point. This proves both orthogonality clauses, uniqueness/formula for every admissible scalar, and the explicit pointwise equation. No limiting operation is present.

All derivative-definition guards are supplied by the direct H002 input.
